item.title: National Guard member arrested in DC, accused of drawing gun on fellow Guard member
item.description: A member of the Georgia National Guard deployed in Washington, D.C., as part of a task force to fight crime, has been arrested for pulling a gun on a fellow Guard member in an alleged dispute over regulation haircuts.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Mail-in voters weigh flying to vote in person and other backup plans amid uncertainty
item.description: Voters and election officials are navigating uncertainty about mail-in voting for the midterms as the legal fight drags on over the U.S. Postal Service plan for President Trump's bid for restrictions.

item.title: Republicans kick off a 'Trumpapalooza' of a midterm convention Wednesday in Texas
item.description: Republicans have never held a midterm convention before. But there's also never been a president like Donald Trump. Billed as a "Trumpapalooza," the unprecedented event kicks of in Dallas Wednesday.

item.title: Judges may face unprecedented decisions this election. A new guide seeks to help
item.description: The idea of law enforcement taking possession of ballots in the middle of an active election used to be considered impossible. Now, it's a scenario voting officials — and judges — are training for.

item.title: The 2026 midterm general election season is upon us. Here's what to watch
item.description: The week of Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season. President Trump's unpopularity and Democratic enthusiasm means control of Congress is on the ballot.

item.title: What to know about Canada's escalating trade war with the U.S.
item.description: Canada struck back at U.S. President Donald Trump on Tuesday with tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. goods. The outcome could resonate far beyond Canada.

item.title: Trump's construction projects are transforming the capital
item.description: President Trump is transforming Washington. New York Magazine's Ben Terris says the ballroom, the planned arch and other changes are an attempt to achieve "architectural immortality."

item.title: With the midterms fast approaching, campaign season begins
item.description: Labor Day marks the unofficial kickoff of the general election season as Republicans work to maintain control of the House and the Senate amid President Trump's unpopular second term.
